paragraphs.zh: 8.根据权利要求1-7任一项所述的制备方法，其特征在于，步骤(2)中使用的溶剂为乙腈、DMF、DMSO或THF中的任意一种或至少两种的组合；
paragraphs.en: 8. The preparation method according to any one of claims 1-7, characterised in that the solvent used in step (2) is any one of acetonitrile, DMF, DMSO or THF, or a combination of at least two of them;
paragraphs.notes: Claims on this page carry ordinal numbers (8., 9., 10.), not [00NN] description paragraph markers, so no bracketed marker exists to preserve.

paragraphs.zh: 优选地，步骤(2)中相对于1mol的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐，所述溶剂的用量为700～3500mL；
paragraphs.en: Preferably, in step (2), relative to 1 mol of the 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate salt, the amount of said solvent is 700 to 3500 mL;
paragraphs.notes: Sub-paragraph of claim 8. 苯甲酸盐 is a benzoate salt; the counter-ion is not stated here.

paragraphs.zh: 优选地，步骤(2)中所述反应完成后经过酸化得到所述2-氯-3-烷氧基甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸；
paragraphs.en: Preferably, after the reaction in step (2) is complete, acidification gives said 2-chloro-3-alkoxymethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid;
paragraphs.notes: Sub-paragraph of claim 8. 烷氧基 is the generic 'alkoxy', not a specific chain length.

paragraphs.zh: 优选地，所述酸化使用的酸为盐酸；
paragraphs.en: Preferably, the acid used for said acidification is hydrochloric acid;

paragraphs.zh: 优选地，所述酸化后反应体系的pH值为2～3。
paragraphs.en: Preferably, the pH of the reaction system after said acidification is 2 to 3.
paragraphs.notes: Sub-paragraph of claim 8; closes the claim with a full stop.

paragraphs.zh: 9.根据权利要求1-8任一项所述的制备方法，其特征在于，步骤(2)中所述反应的温度为-5～15℃；
paragraphs.en: 9. The preparation method according to any one of claims 1-8, characterised in that the temperature of the reaction in step (2) is -5 to 15 degrees C;

paragraphs.zh: 优选地，步骤(2)中所述2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐分批加入步骤(2)的反应体系中，所述2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐的总加料时间为1～3h；
paragraphs.en: Preferably, in step (2) said 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate salt is added in batches to the reaction system of step (2), and the total addition time of said 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate salt is 1 to 3 h;

paragraphs.zh: 优选地，步骤(2)中所述反应的时间为3～6h。
paragraphs.en: Preferably, the reaction time in step (2) is 3 to 6 h.

paragraphs.zh: 10.根据权利要求1-9任一项所述制备方法，其特征在于，包括步骤如下：
paragraphs.en: 10. The preparation method according to any one of claims 1-9, characterised in that it comprises the following steps:

paragraphs.zh: (1)原料2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯在碱性物质存在下于三级醇溶剂中发生酯解反应，25～40℃反应5～12h，得到2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐，相对于1mol所述2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯，所述三级醇溶剂的用量为700～3500mL，所述2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯与碱性物质的摩尔比为1:(1～1.1)；
paragraphs.en: (1) The starting material methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate undergoes an ester-cleavage reaction in a tertiary alcohol solvent in the presence of a basic substance, reacting at 25 to 40 degrees C for 5 to 12 h, to give the 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate salt; relative to 1 mol of said methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate, the amount of said tertiary alcohol solvent is 700 to 3500 mL, and the molar ratio of said methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate to the basic substance is 1:(1 to 1.1);
paragraphs.notes: Step (1) of claim 10. 酯解反应 is literally an 'ester-cleavage reaction'; whether it is meant as saponification or as transesterification is not stated, so it is translated literally. 三级醇 is 'tertiary alcohol' (a class, no specific alcohol named). 碱性物质 is the generic 'basic substance'. Note this step's solvent is a tertiary alcohol, whereas claim 8 lists acetonitrile / DMF / DMSO / THF for step (2).

paragraphs.zh: (2)2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐在碱性物质存在下与醇反应，或者将2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐与碱金属醇盐反应，所述2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐与醇的摩尔比为1:(1.05～1.35)，与碱性物质的摩尔比为1:(1.2～1.5)，所述2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐与碱金属醇盐的摩尔比为1:(1.2～1.5)，反应时间3～6h，反应温度为-5～15℃，经脱溶、水稀释、酸化、过滤和烘干后得到所述2-氯-3-烷氧基甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸。
paragraphs.en: (2) The 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate salt is reacted with an alcohol in the presence of a basic substance, or the 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate salt is reacted with an alkali metal alkoxide; the molar ratio of said 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate salt to the alcohol is 1:(1.05 to 1.35) and to the basic substance is 1:(1.2 to 1.5), the molar ratio of said 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate salt to the alkali metal alkoxide is 1:(1.2 to 1.5), the reaction time is 3 to 6 h and the reaction temperature is -5 to 15 degrees C; after solvent removal, dilution with water, acidification, filtration and drying, said 2-chloro-3-alkoxymethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid is obtained.
paragraphs.notes: Step (2) of claim 10, and the last text on the page. Two alternative routes are claimed: salt + alcohol + base, or salt + alkali metal alkoxide. 脱溶 is solvent removal / desolventisation. Neither the alcohol nor the alkoxide is identified by chain length, so the 烷氧基 (alkoxy) of the product is left generic.
